name: shortest linear recurrence that generates a sequence
mechanism: process the sequence term by term, keeping the shortest linear recurrence consistent so far and, on a discrepancy, correcting it with a scaled copy of an earlier recurrence so the length grows only when forced

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Berlekamp–Massey algorithm' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction:

fails_when: a sequence with no short recurrence yields a recurrence as long as itself
